name: Bone & Gold
material: Light pieces have warm ivory satin ceramic bodies with champagne gold foot rings and top ornaments; dark pieces have near-black charcoal satin ceramic bodies with matching champagne gold details. Clean Art Deco stepped bases, polished narrow gold trim, refined contemporary Staunton shapes. No anatomical bone or skulls.
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a production 2D chess sprite atlas made from photorealistic product renders, not cartoon art.
Create one landscape 1536 by 1024 PNG image with a genuinely transparent alpha background. EXACT layout: a perfectly regular invisible grid of SIX COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, every cell is 256 pixels wide and 512 pixels tall. There are exactly TWELVE isolated chess pieces, one in each cell, never crossing cell boundaries. No board and no labels or text of any kind. Column order from left to right is PAWN, ROOK, KNIGHT, BISHOP, QUEEN, KING. Top row: the six light-side pieces. Bottom row: the six dark-side pieces. No missing cells, repeated piece types, extra objects or decorations.
Position each piece horizontally centered in its cell, with its physical base at 82 percent of that cell's height. The same realistic physical scale across all cells: king is tallest at approximately 65 percent of cell height, queen 60 percent, bishop 54 percent, knight 49 percent, rook 44 percent, pawn 37 percent. Bases are about 55 percent of cell width. Every piece must fit completely inside its own cell, with clear generous transparent padding between pieces. All pieces have precisely the same fixed viewing angle: orthographic product camera elevated approximately 50 degrees above the horizontal, looking down enough to see the crown/top and still recognize the full side silhouette. This is for a flat top-down chessboard with slightly angled photographic sprites. No perspective size differences between columns or rows. All six knights, bishops, kings etc must retain recognizability: a horse head for knight, clean diagonal slot in the bishop mitre, queen crown, and distinct taller king with simple cross.
Studio-photography realism, beautiful soft specular reflections and restrained subtle surface texture, premium material quality, smooth high-resolution render without coarse facets. Gentle identical lighting from the upper left. No hard cast shadow beyond the object itself, no background plane, no visible horizon, no backdrop or contact cards, no baked checker pattern. Transparent background means actual alpha, not a painted transparency checkerboard. Avoid any humans, text, watermark, characters, cartoon, sci-fi, animation, game UI.
Material direction: Light pieces have warm ivory satin ceramic bodies with champagne gold foot rings and top ornaments; dark pieces have near-black charcoal satin ceramic bodies with matching champagne gold details. Clean Art Deco stepped bases, polished narrow gold trim, refined contemporary Staunton shapes. No anatomical bone or skulls.

name: Metal
material: Light pieces are brushed silver stainless steel and dark pieces are deep gunmetal titanium. Precision machined sculptural modern forms, satin grain, reflective metal chamfers, controlled softbox reflections. Geometric but instantly recognizable Staunton piece identities. No gold.

name: Modern Simple
material: Light pieces are warm chalk-white matte porcelain and dark pieces are charcoal-black matte ceramic. Smooth minimal conical bodies, gentle rounded bases, simplified unmistakable Staunton crowns and elegant angular horse knights. No gold or metal, no decorative rings, no faceted low-poly surfaces.
